BluePearl Pet Hospital – serving Fort Lauderdale and south Florida.
We are located in east Fort Lauderdale, and we serve pets and their families in Broward, Miami-Dade and Palm Beach counties.
Our reviews.
Our services.
When your pet needs emergency care, seconds count. Our team is ready to provide expert care 24/7 in case of a pet emergency. If your pet requires a veterinary specialist, we are ready for that too. Our experienced team of veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
Emergency
Call ahead to our 24-hour emergency vet hospital in Fort Lauderdale and let us know you’re coming. No appointment is necessary.
Learn more about your emergency visit
.
Specialty care
Specialists at BluePearl veterinary hospitals work directly with your primary care vet to understand your pet’s condition and develop the appropriate treatment plan. Visits to our specialists are usually by referral from your primary care vet and by appointment.

About BluePearl Pet Hospital Fort Lauderdale.
Our 24-hour pet hospital is open every day of the year, with an ER veterinarian and support team on-site at all times to deal with emergencies.
Dr. Ira M. Zaslow opened the hospital in 2011 and built a team of board-certified veterinary specialists.
The hospital has advanced equipment such as a CT scanner and is fully equipped to meet the emergency and specialty needs of pet owners in Fort Lauderdale and surrounding South Florida communities. We are proud to be one of the few veterinary clinics offering physical therapy to improve the well-being of your pets.
This hospital was formerly known as Lauderdale Veterinary Specialists.

At BluePearl Pet Hospitals, providing our customers with remarkable service is a top priority. We’re committed to making your veterinary visit as smooth as possible.

Testimonials.
I’m a cat mom of two beautiful boys, and have had my share of the nightmares of the trips to the emergency animal hospitals. I swore I would never go back to the last animal hospital, so we decided to take him to BluePearl. I called ahead to let them know I was coming. I knew immediately after I hung up the phone it was going to be different this time, and it was. Imagine a hospital that actually puts your pet’s care first and doesn’t immediately ask for $$. The nurse was as sweet as can be, and Dr. Lewis was amazing. She spent a lot of time with us, was patient, kind, and didn’t have one foot out the door like most places. I’m very optimistic that Teddy will get better with her treatment plan, but just knowing that Dr. Lewis and BluePearl are there if we need them gives me peace of mind – and that’s something you can’t put a price tag on. Thank you Dr. Lewis, and BluePearl 😻
–Fran Z.
“To all of the staff at BluePearl Ft. Lauderdale, words cannot express how grateful I am to have found you! I was so nervous and anxious when my 15 year old dog, Jake, went into respiratory distress after having a seizure.
I just want to make special mention of a few people because of the attention they provided to me, my friend who met me there, and my baby Jake. Breanna, from the moment I called, guided me, tried to keep me calm, advising me what to do. She was so caring, was waiting for me when we arrived, and gave me a sense of peace amidst my chaos. Jerome and Dr. Abdo, for putting up with my inability to make hard decisions. Despite the chaos, they still took the time to explain everything calmly and patiently, which helped me make a decision I didn’t regret! The young lady who was comforting my baby while oxygenating him gave me a sense of peace he was in good hands when I had to leave him for the night. Aliyah who helped me walk as I felt faint and about to collapse. Your warmth and kindness can never be repaid! Natalie for the care and love you showed my baby and for helping us back to the car.
I commend you all for the work that you do. I believe you know the true meaning of taking care of your furry family member(s) and their parents at their moment of need. Everyone, from start to finish, I thank you all from the bottom of my heart. May God bless each and everyone of you!”
–Ruth T.
